test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 29 Jun, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Nip in the bud

options.text: To stop something from growing beyond limit
To complete a prolonged or unfinished work
To suppress something at an early stage

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"Nip in the bud"** means:

 
 
• To suppress or stop something at an early stage before it has the chance to grow or develop. (शुरुआत में ही रोक देना)
 
 
 
• **Example: **They decided to **nip the rumor** in the bud before it spread any further.
 
• The correct meaning of the idiom is **"To suppress something at an early stage"** (शुरुआत में ही रोक देना).
 
 
• **Example:** The manager nipped the issue in the bud by addressing the team immediately.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1: To publicise a long-kept secret** (किसी लंबे समय से गुप्त रखे गए रहस्य को प्रचारित करना)

 
 
• **Example:** The journalist decided to publicise the long-kept secret about the politician.
 
 
 
• **Option 2: To stop something from growing beyond limit** (किसी चीज को सीमा से बाहर बढ़ने से रोकना)
 
 
• **Example:** The gardener pruned the plants to stop them from growing beyond limit.
 
 
 
• **Option 3: To complete a prolonged or unfinished work** (किसी लंबे समय से अधूरे कार्य को पूरा करना)
 
 
• **Example:** He finally managed to complete the prolonged project that had been pending for months.
 
 

3c6:Td77,
The correct answer is **Option 1**.
